result.coreDiagnosis: The candidate's extensive job hopping across four roles in just over three years, coupled with most of their experience being at the Associate PM level, creates a significant stability risk and level mismatch for a mid-level Product Manager (Technical) role.
result.roleFitVerdict: The candidate demonstrates strong technical fluency and impact for a PM(T) role, but their short tenures and Associate PM experience make them a high-risk fit for a stable mid-level position expecting 3-5 years of consistent Product Manager ownership.
recruiterScan: (Risk) Severe job hopping: Held 4 roles in ~3 years, indicating high churn risk for a mid-level hire.

topHiringRisks.title: High Job Churn
topHiringRisks.description: The candidate's pattern of short tenures (8, 4, 5 months) across multiple companies in a short timeframe raises significant concerns about their stability and long-term commitment, which is critical for a mid-level PM hire.

topHiringRisks.title: Level Discrepancy
topHiringRisks.description: While the candidate's resume states '5+ years' and their current title is 'Product Manager,' the majority of their actual PM/APM experience (~3 years) is at the Associate Product Manager level. This suggests they may not have the sustained, end-to-end ownership at the Product Manager level expected for a 3-5 year mid-level role.

topHiringRisks.title: Inflated Experience Claim
topHiringRisks.description: The '5+ Years' listed in the header likely includes education, as their professional product management tenure is closer to 3 years. This discrepancy can signal a lack of transparency or a misunderstanding of how professional experience is counted, impacting trust.

rewriteExample.before: Orchestrated high-impact career workshops and integrated structured feedback loops, resulting in a 34% boost in learner satisfaction scores and empowering 100+ participants in their career journeys.
rewriteExample.after: Designed and implemented a scalable feedback collection system for 100+ workshop participants, feeding insights directly into the product roadmap for career pathway improvements, boosting learner satisfaction 34% and informing feature prioritization for the mentor-matching engine.
rewriteExample.explanation: The original bullet reads more like program management or customer success. The rewrite shifts focus to owning a 'scalable feedback collection system' and explicitly links the insights to 'product roadmap' and 'feature prioritization' for a specific 'mentor-matching engine,' demonstrating technical product ownership and influence on development for a PM(T) role.
